test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following films was directed by Satyajit Ray?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pather Panchali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pather Panchali** is an epic drama film written and **directed by Satyajit Ray** and produced by the Government of West Bengal.
 
• It is an adaptation of **Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay's **1929 Bengali novel of the same name and marked Ray's directorial debut.
 
• It is an Indian** Bengali-language** film and was **released in 1955.**
 
• Other famous films by** Satyajit Ray** are **Charulata (The Lonely Wife)**** (1964), Aparajito (1956), Jalsaghar (1958), Devi (1960), etc. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kora Kagaz **- It was directed by Anil Ganguly and was released in 1974.
 
• **Mahal **- It is a 1970 Indian mystery thriller film that stars Dev Anand, Asha Parekh, and Farida Jalal and was directed by Kamal Amrohi. 
 
• **Pyaasa - **It is a 1957 movie directed by Guru Dutt.
